test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 16 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: The cost of painting a solid cone at 30 paise per cm² is ₹1056. Find the radius of the cone if its slant height is 36 cm. (Use pi=(22)/(7))
solution:
**Given**

Cost of painting: ₹1056

Cost per cm² of painting: ₹0.30

Slant height (l) of the cone: 36 cm

**Concept Used:**

Total Surface Area of a Cone = πr(r + l)

**Solution:**

Total area painted = Total cost / Cost per cm² = 1056 / 0.30 = 3520 cm²

Total surface area of cone = πr(r + l)&
